scripts.build: node bundle.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync, copyFileSync, cpSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('dist/engine', { recursive: true }); copyFileSync('package.json', 'dist/package.json'); copyFileSync('src/engine/thresholds.yaml', 'dist/engine/thresholds.yaml'); cpSync('src/knowledge', 'dist/knowledge', { recursive: true }); cpSync('src/llm/prompts', 'dist/llm/prompts', { recursive: true });"
